narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Eleven take away five leaves six, so eleven fifths has six whole units.
<bookmark mark='trays'/>Six full trays of fifths would need thirty pieces, but there are only eleven.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Taking five away once is not enough. You must keep making full trays.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, count the pieces in the full trays and add the pieces left.
<bookmark mark='sum'/>Six and two make eight, ten and one make eleven, and eight and one make nine.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the recap board shows the check: 2 × 3 + 2 = 8, 2 × 5 + 1 = 11, 2 × 4 + 1 = 9

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu takes five away from eleven and says eleven fifths has six whole units. Six full trays would need thirty pieces, and there are only eleven, so the bubble is struck.
